entries.mechanism: The Alabama DHR Public Assistance Payment Manual (Appendix N Section 2) orders earned-income work-expense deductions as "1. 20% of gross earnings ... 2. Child care or care of an incapacitated adult". Both engines encode both steps - PolicyEngine's al_tanf_countable_earned_income deducts childcare_expenses, and the Axiom payment-computation module subtracts its child_or_incapacitated_adult_care_expenses free input - but the populace projection carried no mapping rule for that input and the populace loader did not extract the ECPS childcare_expenses fact, so the harness fed PolicyEngine the household's imputed childcare while Axiom's input defaulted to zero. A harness gap, not an engine or encoding defect (initially misfiled as a rulespec encoding gap in rulespec-us#1184; the rulespec module already encodes the step-2 deduction). Fixed by populating the CHILDCARE_EXPENSES household fact in populations/populace_us.py and adding the child_or_incapacitated_adult_care_expenses monthly rule to populace_input_mapping.yaml - with the fix the projected input is 35.79/month and Axiom computes 53 vs PolicyEngine's 53.390533, inside the suite's $25 tolerance, so this entry expires at the next report refresh. Exact-household replay in policyengine-us from this repo's venv: size-2 unit, ages 23/0, yearly employment income 4296 (358/month) gives al_tanf 17.60 with zero childcare (matching Axiom's rounded 18 = 304 payment standard minus countable 286, per the manual's round-to-nearest-dollar rule), and exactly 53.390533 - the reported right value - with yearly childcare_expenses 429.4864 (35.7905/month). The residual is the childcare deduction the bridge withheld from Axiom.

Same harness gap as ecps-37103: both engines encode the manual's step-2 child-care deduction, but the populace projection fed childcare only to PolicyEngine (Axiom's child_or_incapacitated_adult_care_expenses input defaulted to zero; fixed by the CHILDCARE_EXPENSES fact feed and mapping rule, so this entry expires at the next report refresh). Size-6 unit, yearly earnings 3567 (297.25/month), payment standard 488: Axiom computes 488 minus countable 238 (0.8 x 297.24 = 237.79 rounded to the nearest dollar per the manual) = 250, the left value. PolicyEngine's right value 279.929443 reconciles with a monthly childcare deduction of 29.7294 (356.75/year), identical to the deduction implied by ecps-37415 for the same earnings pattern; with the fix Axiom computes 280, a 0.07 residual inside the $25 tolerance.

Size-8 unit, yearly earnings 3567 (297.25/month), monthly unearned 41.67, payment standard 584: Axiom computes 584 minus countable 279 (237.79 earned + 41.67 unearned = 279.46 rounded to the nearest dollar per the manual) = 305, the left value. PolicyEngine's right value 334.262756 reconciles with the same 29.7294/month childcare deduction implied by ecps-37187 for the identical earnings pattern; with the fix Axiom computes 334, a 0.26 residual inside the $25 tolerance.
